description: Supercharge Rwandan businesses and tech teams with autonomous AI agents. Cloud computers running 24/7, browser automation, and deep Telegram integration.
h1: Empower Rwandan Innovation with Autonomous Cloud Agents
sub: Deploy persistent AI bots with isolated cloud computers that research, write code, and execute complex workflows 24/7 across Kigali and beyond.
audience: Kigali tech startups, specialty coffee exporters, regional East African logistics operators, eco-tourism agencies, and agile developer teams.
manifesto: From Kigali's burgeoning innovation hubs to dynamic regional trade corridors, Ceyo gives ambitious Rwandan teams dedicated 24/7 cloud agents that research markets, write production code, and handle complex workflows seamlessly around the clock.

uses.d: Coding agents write, test, and host web applications inside their isolated cloud environments, keeping sprint cycles moving rapidly without local server overhead.
Autonomous browser agents track global commodity exchange rates, verify international freight schedules, and compile competitive pricing reports automatically.
Bots monitor tour bookings, coordinate communications across hotel and transport partners, and organize guest schedules for Volcanoes and Akagera expeditions.
Agents monitor East African Community trade portals, track regulatory updates, and fill out repetitive transit paperwork via automated web browsers.
Deploy specialized Telegram bots and collaborative team chats that answer client inquiries, trigger workflows, and summarize critical leads while you sleep.
Schedule autonomous agents to scrape regional development tenders, parse qualification criteria, and generate synthesized brief documents in shared folders.

steps.d: Choose a plan and spin up a secure, isolated cloud computer for your bot in seconds.
Link Telegram, email, and productivity apps, then schedule autonomous tasks and browser research.
Let your bots collaborate in group chats, run code, and execute business routines 24/7.

chapters.d: Your research bot reviews regional news, commodity exchange shifts, and incoming inquiries overnight. It posts an executive bullet summary directly into your team Telegram group.
While you meet clients in downtown Kigali, your agent opens regional logistics portals and updates shipping status sheets. It logs exceptions and flags pending documentation directly.
Your coding agent tests new backend endpoints and deploys a preview website on its isolated computer. You review changes and trigger voice calls with your bot to refine tasks.
Even when your laptop is shut down and phone is off, scheduled routines continue running uninterrupted. Long memory preserves operational context for the next business morning.

faq.q: How does the pricing and 3-day free trial work?
faq.a: Ceyo offers Plus ($20/month), Pro ($60/month), and Ultra ($120/month) plans. Every plan includes a 3-day free trial with up to 1,000,000 tokens per day; a card is linked upon signup and only charged if you do not cancel before the trial finishes.

faq.q: Can Ceyo agents work if my phone or computer is disconnected?
faq.a: Yes. Every bot runs in an independent, isolated cloud environment that functions 24/7 continuously, regardless of your local internet connectivity or device power status.

faq.q: Which languages and regional contexts do Ceyo bots support?
faq.a: Ceyo agents process and communicate fluently in English, French, Swahili, and Kinyarwanda, enabling smooth interactions across domestic Rwandan operations and global partners.

faq.q: How do Ceyo bots collaborate inside Telegram?
faq.a: You can deploy bots as personal Telegram assistants or add several bots into a Telegram group chat, where they collaborate as specialized teammates on research, writing, and operations.

faq.q: Can Ceyo execute code and automate web tasks?
faq.a: Yes. Your agents feature autonomous web browser capabilities to navigate portals and fill forms, alongside a dedicated coding agent that writes, tests, and deploys code in the cloud.
